feeds.title: The ZipCPU by Gisselquist Technology
feeds.description: The ZipCPU blog, featuring how to discussions of FPGA and soft-core CPU design. This site will be focused on Verilog solutions, using exclusively OpenSource IP products for FPGA design. Particular focus areas include topics often left out of more mainstream FPGA design courses such as how to debug an FPGA design.

feeds.title: FPGA Coding
feeds.description: Learn to code FPGA devices in Verilog. I have worked as a software engineer in the video gaming industry for over 20 years. In my work, low-level software that interacts with the hardware has always been a favorite space. I've enjoyed assembly language programming for many CPU architectures including 6502, 6809, Z-80, 80×86, PIC, and AVR. And even pixel and vertex shaders in the days before high-level shading languages.

feeds.title: Plunify Blog

Plunify makes software that optimizes IC chip designs, using statistical and machine learning methods, making it easier and faster for FPGA and ASIC engineers to increase performance in fewer number of iterations.
